title: Three steps. About twenty-one days.
lede: From first call to first booked job through the new system — here’s the standard path.

steps.title: Audit & benchmark
steps.body: We pull your current numbers, run a tech audit, and benchmark against three local competitors. Free, no obligation, you keep the report.

steps.title: Plan & instrument
steps.body: We agree on the cost-per-job target, then wire up call tracking, attribution, and the dashboards before any spend goes live.

steps.title: Ship & iterate
steps.body: Site goes live, ads turn on, and we meet weekly for the first month. After that, monthly check-ins and a one-page report.
